semantics.identity_rule: Each application/invitation/offer workflow has explicit identity.
semantics.acceptance_rule: Offer acceptance is explicit and does not itself silently create arbitrary runtime/AccessCore rights.
semantics.project_rule: Accepted workflow may trigger a separate Project participation/contract creation operation.
semantics.employment_rule: Employment arrangement, where modeled, becomes an explicit long-running/composite Project.
semantics.authority_rule: Market workflow state and system authorization remain separate.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
